entries.dialogueText: Nia Morgna, the Minister of Justice and the head of the Anti-Corruption Police, entered the room. She barely looked at me as she took her place before the judges.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“By the President's order, we began..."
entries.dialogueText: “By the President's order, we began a probe into the powerful media mogul Marcel Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“During our investigations, we have..."
entries.dialogueText: “During our investigations, we have found dire incriminating evidence against Mr. President himself.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I, being a member of the cabinet a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I, being a member of the cabinet and having worked with the defendant for many years, did not want to believe what I heard and saw. Yet the evidence could not be ignored."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“My Anti-Corruption Police force wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “My Anti-Corruption Police force was asked to look into Walter Tusk, the spokesperson for the Lotherberg Group.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“According to the evidence, Mr. Man..."
entries.dialogueText: “According to the evidence, Mr. Manger offered the President a personal stake in Underhall Construction."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“What we found was, quite frankly,..."
entries.dialogueText: “What we found was, quite frankly, shocking.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I sat there, quietly seething."
entries.dialogueText: I sat there, quietly seething.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I have dedicated my life to the pu..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have dedicated my life to the pursuit of justice, and that dedication has led me to a position of utmost responsibility."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The President's business bailout w..."
entries.dialogueText: “The President's business bailout was a direct result of hidden dealings with Mr. Tusk."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“We found that shortly after Mr. Ra..."
entries.dialogueText: “We found that shortly after Mr. Rayne took office, Mr. Koronti offered the President what amounted to government control over Sordland's major media in exchange for special protections for his conglomerate, Heart of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I am obligated to uphold my ideals..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am obligated to uphold my ideals by revealing the reality behind Anton Rayne, the President of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“President Rayne subsequently chose..."
entries.dialogueText: “President Rayne subsequently chose Underhall Construction as the contractor for his new government megaproject, siphoning millions of SR from the government to his company.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The tax cuts for large corporation..."
entries.dialogueText: “The tax cuts for large corporations were the product of a hidden deal between Mr. Tusk and Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I hereby present the following all..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hereby present the following allegations against Anton Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Mr. Tusk engaged the President in..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Tusk engaged the President in flat-out bribery to ensure that his company Underhall Construction would be selected as the main contractor for a major infrastructure project.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The President accepted. Needless t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The President accepted. Needless to say, this deal is a horrifying breach of democratic values.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Our investigations have revealed P..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our investigations have revealed President Rayne's involvement in a bribery scheme with PFJP leader Frens Ricter.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“As you can see, there is substanti..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you can see, there is substantial incriminating evidence against Anton Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Our investigations have revealed P..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our investigations have revealed President Rayne's involvement in a bribery scheme with PFJP leader Frens Ricter.”

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker

entries.dialogueText: “Silence! Silence in the court!”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“As the man holding the highest off..."
entries.dialogueText: “As the man holding the highest office in this country, he should be a shining example of democracy. Instead, he has abused his position for his own personal gain and desecrated Sordland's democratic ideals."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I hope this court sees the ugly tr..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope this court sees the ugly truth and relieves Anton Rayne from his presidency once and for all.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“We have found a direct conflict of..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have found a direct conflict of interest linked to the Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development, Gus Manger.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Our investigations found that duri..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our investigations found that during the constitutional reform process, Anton Rayne promised Albin Clavin the position of Vice President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Mr. President has been involved in..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President has been involved in the obstruction of justice by tipping off the subject of a government investigation."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Our investigations found a large s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our investigations found a large sum of money transferred between Anton Rayne and Albin Clavin during the constitutional reform process.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Objection!”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The person in question is Marcel K..."
entries.dialogueText: “The person in question is Marcel Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loud chatter started spreading thro..."
entries.dialogueText: Loud chatter started spreading through the courtroom.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“In return for his support in the A..."
entries.dialogueText: “In return for his support in the Assembly, Frens Ricter received a large sum of money from the President.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“All evidence suggests that this wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “All evidence suggests that this was a bribe meant to secure Mr. Clavin's support for the constitutional changes in the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“It is therefore no coincidence tha..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is therefore no coincidence that, not long after Mr. Clavin supported the President's reforms in the Assembly, he was offered the Vice Presidency.”
